ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since point D is the midpoint of line segment AB, and AB$=6$, \\
it follows that BD$=\frac{1}{2}$AB$=3$, \\
Since CD$=1$, \\
it follows that BC$=BD-CD=3-1=\boxed{2}$.
